scientific_boundary: Centered logits can be recovered from strictly positive softmax probabilities, but a clean-conditioned response cannot be recovered when the paired clean probabilities were never saved. Using the mean corrupted view as a surrogate base or joining K0-A CIFAR-100 base logits to Phase-A1a CIFAR-10 corruptions would change the frozen estimand.
